summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the Stripe->Razorpay migration and INR pricing. Backend: rewrote the payments section of /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for Razorpay (checkout graceful 400, HMAC signature verify matrix, ownership 403, webhook signature validation + paid propagation, status 200/404) and re-ran full suite: 41/41 passed. Frontend: verified INR formatting on /services (all 7 packages in en-IN format, no $), unauth Book Package -> /login, client login, package booking -> /api/payments/checkout call -> graceful error toast 'Payment gateway error: Authentication failed', client dashboard Pay button triggers same flow with rupee amounts, /payment/success static page renders, admin login lands on /admin, admin stats (Revenue in Rs), edit modal 'Quoted Amount (INR)' saves and reflects, all 3 admin tabs load, contact form submits, home nav OK, mobile 390px no horizontal overflow. One real defect found and fixed in scope: public/index.html changes (Razorpay checkout.js script tag + page title) were NOT being served because CRA dev-server caches the HTML template at boot - window.Razorpay was undefined; a frontend supervisor restart fixed it and the SDK now loads (typeof window.Razorpay === 'function').

minor.issue: Raw gateway exception is echoed to the client (detail='Payment gateway error: Authentication failed'). Correct 400 status and non-leaky today, but consider a generic user-facing message + logged internals so a future Razorpay error body cannot leak key/account details.
If RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET were unset it defaults to empty string and would still compute an HMAC (no explicit misconfiguration error). Behaviour is safe (always 400) but the failure is silent.

ui_bugs.issue: Razorpay checkout.js script tag / title were not in the served HTML until frontend was restarted. Any future edit to public/index.html needs `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` - hot reload does not pick it up. Fixed by restart during this run.

Clicking 'Book Package' while unauthenticated correctly redirects to /login, but after successful login the user is sent to /services instead of back to /book?service=...&package=... - the intended package selection is lost.
Leftover Stripe copy: 'Approve & pay via Stripe' (line ~220) still shown on the Custom Quote sidebar after the Razorpay migration.
Package highlight still reads 'Payments (Stripe)' - surfaces on /services cards.

issues: Error/success toasts render over the navbar and visually cover the Logout / Get Started buttons for their whole duration (observed on /dashboard and /admin). Consider offsetting the toaster below the header.

action_items: Replace 'Approve & pay via Stripe' with Razorpay in BookService.jsx quote sidebar and 'Payments (Stripe)' in services_catalog.py app_pro highlights.
Persist the post-login redirect target so 'Book Package' -> login -> returns to the booking form with the chosen package.
Offset sonner toaster so toasts do not overlay navbar action buttons.
Optional: return a generic message for gateway failures and log the raw Razorpay error server-side.
Remember: edits to /app/frontend/public/index.html require a frontend restart to take effect.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still imports emergentintegrations StripeCheckout/CheckoutSessionRequest although Stripe is fully removed - dead import, drop it to avoid a hard startup failure if the package is ever unavailable.
RazorpayVerifyRequest is declared inline with __import__('pydantic').BaseModel inside server.py - move it to models.py with a normal import for readability.
/api/payments/status/{order_id} is unauthenticated: any caller who knows an order_id can read status + booking_id. Add auth/ownership check.
checkout stores both session_id and order_id with the same value for legacy schema continuity; plan a migration to drop session_id.
razorpay.js resolves/rejects a Promise from an async executor; errors thrown before the try block would be swallowed - acceptable but worth tightening.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; login-redirect target + leftover Stripe copy are the gaps)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is Razorpay-ready: TestPayments covers checkout->400 (placeholder keys), verify bad-sig 400 / good-sig-no-txn 404 / good-sig+seeded-txn 200 with booking->in_progress, 403 cross-user, 401 unauth, 422 missing fields, webhook bad/missing sig 400 and valid sig marking paid. Signature helper _rzp_signature() reads RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET from /app/backend/.env. Do NOT expect /payments/checkout to return 200 until real Razorpay keys are configured. Frontend: window.Razorpay loads only after a frontend restart following index.html edits.
rca_of_the_issue: Razorpay SDK appeared missing on the frontend (window.Razorpay undefined, no script tag in served HTML, title still 'Emergent | Fullstack App'). Root cause: CRA/webpack-dev-server renders public/index.html through HtmlWebpackPlugin at server start and does not watch it, so the newly added <script src='https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js'> was never served. Reproduced with curl on both localhost:3000 and the public URL. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`; verified typeof window.Razorpay === 'function' afterwards.
